en.title: Magic: The Gathering Unveils Star Trek Cards, Including Picard's Iconic Tea Order
en.summary: Wizards of the Coast is boldly going where no card game has gone before with its upcoming Magic: The Gathering x Star Trek set. IGN has exclusively revealed seven new cards, showcasing a blend of iconic moments and characters from across the Star Trek universe.
en.body:
The final frontier for **Magic: The Gathering** in 2026 is a trip through space and time with the **Star Trek** collaboration, set to launch on November 13. While Wizards of the Coast has teased the set, IGN has secured exclusive first looks at seven new cards, offering a glimpse into how the legendary franchise is being translated to the tabletop.

These newly revealed cards span the rich history of Star Trek, from the original series all the way through to modern entries like *Lower Decks*. This diverse selection ensures that fans from every era will find something to connect with. Among the highlights is the artifact card simply titled 'Tea, Earl Grey, Hot.' This common card, costing two mana, not only references Captain Picard's quintessential beverage but also offers significant utility. As a 'Food' subtype card, it nets a player a card upon entering the battlefield. When sacrificed, it can either restore 3 life, a standard Food ability, or deal 2 damage directly to an opponent, adding an aggressive option.

## A Journey Through the Multiverse

Beyond the charming nod to Picard's daily routine, more mechanically complex cards are also making their debut. 'Mirror Universe Intrusion' stands out as a sorcery that, for a base cost, offers a flavor win. However, for an additional four mana kicker, it transforms into a powerful board control tool, granting all your creatures menace and essentially allowing you to steal an opponent's board state. This nine-mana investment represents a significant swing in a game, offering a way to overcome overwhelming odds. The card also boasts special 'booster fun' treatments, including a borderless version, adding collectible appeal for dedicated fans.

## Echoes of the Final Frontier

The **Magic: The Gathering x Star Trek** set promises to be a treat for long-time fans of both franchises. The inclusion of cards like 'Mirror Universe Intrusion' and the homage to Picard's drink demonstrates a deep understanding of what makes Star Trek resonate. This set isn't just about slapping Star Trek art onto Magic cards; it's about capturing the spirit and memorable moments of the universe. The ability to interact with iconic elements, whether it's a specific character's habit or a pivotal event, adds a layer of immersive storytelling that appeals to the passionate fanbase. This careful integration of lore into gameplay mechanics is what will likely make this set a standout release for collectors and players alike.

## What's Next

With the November 13 release date rapidly approaching, players can anticipate further reveals leading up to the launch. The seven cards revealed by IGN are just a small taste of the full set, which promises to delve deeper into the vast lore of **Star Trek**.
